# LORDES — Pixel art

Generated with the built-in image_gen tool, using the user's pixel portrait collage as style reference. Final PNGs preserve actual alpha transparency.

Final prompt set:
- carvalho.png: preserve the chunky oak log and oak leaf and their colors; remove all ochre background; transparent alpha; no backdrop, text or floor.
- maca.png: preserve the red apple, green leaf and brown stem; remove all yellow background; transparent alpha; crisp square pixel edges.
- trigo.png: preserve golden wheat and red tie; remove all teal background; transparent alpha; no backdrop, text or floor.
- granito.png: single angular granite sprite; black, gray and white facets; large square pixels; five-gray palette; genuine transparent alpha; no frame, floor or text.
- povo-do-norte.png: preserve commoner's head-and-shoulders pose and identity; grayscale skin, hair, beard, fur and clothing; only the two irises colored icy cyan; remove yellow background; genuine transparent alpha; no surrounding glow or text.
